answer: The protocol enforces Sybil resistance by requiring agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards, verified through unpredictable retrieval audits where any failed proof of replication triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of deposited funds. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct data. Like an opal reflecting light, the verifier shifts between violet and copper data-segments to detect inconsistencies in the custody audit.
